* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image of 27 September 2019<ref name="ht-pu-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f2c3fe/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/puck.gif puck.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0f2c3fe 0f2c3fe] (27 September 2019).</ref>, no errata mark. Your Rebel pilots aboard snub fighters here are forfeit +1.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Puck (Errata)]]): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-pu-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/puck.gif puck.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); the destiny sentence now comes first and the pilot icon “2.” moves after it; a small “71” is added beside the Premium icon. Text: “When choosing the destiny value of this card, must use 3 Force to choose 7. [Pilot] 2. May deploy as a 'react.' Your Rebel pilots aboard snub fighters here are forfeit +1.”
Versions follow Bill's ruling of 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC card image is a version (the PC's own E marks count only its announced errata).
